take_homes: Split into several agents only for different access, dialect or stance. Otherwise one agent with a good prompt.
Give the synthesizer a framework (diagnosis, guiding policy, coherent actions). That makes it commit to one view. Better wording alone doesn't.
The risk sits at the handoffs between agents, and the debrief writes the lessons into CLAUDE.md. The briefing is still unverified.
